memory: The feeling of being completely, overwhelmingly driven toward a single focal point. You chase it higher until it settles deep in your bones, reaching the absolute tipping point where all hesitation has to die and you simply have to move.
hardHittingLine:
Higher and higher you chase it

It's deep in your bones, go and take it

This is your moment, now is your time
whyThisLine: It strips away all the preparation and planning. The drive of the obsession eventually leads to this exact realization: the window is open right now, and you must push upward.
